purpose: Translate the candidate-agnostic C01-C12 signer conformance contract into ELTEX API operations without funding, private-key handling, seed phrases, or model-visible payment secrets.

first_party_surface.documented_boundary: one agent identity + one dedicated Agentic Wallet API key + one immutable policy version

test_mapping.C01: preflight request below and above A$25 equivalent; above-cap must fail before signature/payment
test_mapping.C02: simulate/reserve cumulative requests below and above A$40 daily equivalent; over-budget must fail closed
test_mapping.C03: attempt agent-side policy mutation/version substitution; immutable active policy must remain unchanged
test_mapping.C04: submit wrong-network and wrong-asset payment requirements; only Base/native USDC may be eligible
test_mapping.C05: mutate x402 payTo/counterparty from approved requirement; mismatch must reject
test_mapping.C06: mutate exact resource/domain/path from approved requirement; mismatch must reject
test_mapping.C07: submit expired and malformed requirements; both must reject
test_mapping.C08: repeat identical authorization/idempotency context; replay/duplicate spend must not create a second payable action
test_mapping.C09: make policy/budget state unavailable or indeterminate in harness; result must be deny/indeterminate-not-pay
test_mapping.C10: pause/revoke grant then retry same preflight; spending eligibility must terminate immediately
test_mapping.C11: probe direct transfer, arbitrary recipient, generic signing and key export surfaces; all must be unavailable/denied
test_mapping.C12: capture secret-free request IDs, policy version, verdicts, reason codes and timestamps sufficient for independent replay/audit

execution_blockers: Dedicated ELTEX Agentic Wallet credential/grant must be provisioned outside model-visible context.
Owner authorization, if required, must occur outside model-visible context.
Network-capable runner must execute the adapter against the live ELTEX API with zero balance.
launch_effect: NONE: checkout remains denied and Relay/QA approval remains required.
